SYMPTOM: After `docker compose down` (DB reset), all Prisma operations failed: `user.update`, `search.create`, `lLMUsage.create` — 'No record was found for update' or 'depends on records not found'. Even after logging out/in.
CAUSE: `jwt` callback only sets `token.userId` when `user` is present (first sign-in). On subsequent requests it reuses the stale token with the OLD userId from the previous DB. After DB reset, new user gets a different ID.
FIX: In `auth.ts` jwt callback, always look up user by `token.email` if `token.userId` is missing or if `user` is not present — don't trust the cached userId across DB resets. Also change `findUniqueOrThrow` to `findUnique` with null fallback in `checkUsage`.
ADDITIONAL: `incrementUsage` also needs `upsert` instead of `update` to handle missing users gracefully.
